method: First, all 20 full-page screenshots were individually emitted by view_image and inspected for overall layout. Because long images may be downscaled in model display even with original detail, all 10 mobile screenshots were additionally inspected as contiguous 1500-pixel-high original-scale strips arranged left-to-right on temporary boards no larger than 1548x1500. CTA, form, warning, navigation and footer text observations rely on this supplemental native-pixel mobile review rather than the overview alone. Automated assertions were not substituted for visual inspection.

scope.captureRuntime: Local OpenNext/workerd candidate screenshots supplied by parent

limitations: This is Codex screenshot review, not independent human design or business approval. The reviewer previously contributed UI and consultation code.
Desktop/mobile mean browser viewport profiles, not physical hardware, real touch interaction or a mobile OS browser.

Static screenshots cannot prove keyboard behavior, focus order, link destinations, form submission, screen-reader semantics or network isolation; separate automated evidence covers parts of those behaviors.
Membership FAQ rows are collapsed; expanded contents and interaction states were not visible in this set.
Receiving is disabled in these screenshots. Configured receiving/recovery/withdrawal UI states require their separate synthetic fixture and eventual authorized deployment acceptance.
Scene grids are explicit placeholders; no real 3D content, navigation accuracy, permissions or ecological claims were validated.
The original screenshots and page source were not modified. Sharp produced temporary inspection-only crops/composites under /tmp; no production action was performed.

Full-page overview display can shrink fine print. All mobile source pixels were re-inspected in unscaled segments. Desktop overview conclusions establish layout, visible controls and no obvious clipping, not exhaustive word-by-word desktop fine-print verification.
